originalNetlifyError.message: The function exceeds the maximum size of 250 MB

rootCauseEvidence.classification: cloudflare-export included in server function package
evidence: The committed Cloudflare export contains 521 files, including 519 full book payloads and 2 manifests.
Before the fix, app/routes/morse-book-content.books.$slug.tsx imported the Cloudflare export public manifest and used a static fs path rooted at app/client/assets/books/cloudflare-export.
The pre-fix production server bundle contained a static path to app/client/assets/books/cloudflare-export in the local payload fallback route.

The local React Router server bundle itself was about 4 MB, so the deploy failure aligned with Netlify function packaging/upload tracing the large local export directory rather than with a TypeScript or Vite build failure.

fixesMade: Production no longer uses the local /morse-book-content/books/:slug fallback route unless MORSEWORDS_ENABLE_LOCAL_BOOK_CONTENT_ROUTE=1 is explicitly set.
The local fallback route now reads the export manifest dynamically only after the dev/explicit-enable guard, instead of importing the Cloudflare export manifest at module scope.
Client/runtime fallback to /morse-book-content is now dev-only unless VITE_ENABLE_LOCAL_BOOK_CONTENT_ROUTE=1 is explicitly set.
Added npm run books:netlify-function-size-audit to inspect local Netlify/build artifacts after npm run build:netlify.

validationResults.postExportBookRouteValidation: pass locally; real remote Cloudflare validation still blocked until served base URL is provided
validationResults.linkingSitemapAudit: pass, 519 book URLs and 519 audiobook URLs

remainingRisks: Local inspection exposes .netlify/v1/functions as a small shim rather than the exact zipped production upload package; the fix removes the static export fs trace that caused Netlify packaging to include the large local export directory.
Real remote Cloudflare/R2 validation remains blocked until the actual served base URL is available.
nextManualCloudflareR2UploadGate: Do not claim remote Cloudflare validation until VITE_MORSE_BOOK_CONTENT_BASE_URL or PUBLIC_MORSE_BOOK_CONTENT_BASE_URL points to the actual served export and npm run books:cloudflare-post-upload-validation passes.
Remote upload must be sync/delete, overwrite existing keys, and remove stale keys under the book export prefix.
laterStagesPreserved: Non-book sitemap/page work was not started.
Sources/About/repeated-helper-copy content work was not started.
Broad mobile optimization was not started.
